Students fall ill after eating meals in India and Indonesia

In Karnataka, India, 34 students at a school in Raichur fell ill after eating breakfast, with food poisoning suspected. In Patiala, Punjab, several students at a school also became sick, with food poisoning being the suspected cause. Separately, in Indonesia, over 500 students fell ill, and government-supplied meals are being tested.
